rc.task.results
===============

.. py:module:: rc.task.results

.. autoapi-nested-parse::

   **Functionality for processing results generated by ``rc``**



Classes
-------

.. autoapisummary::

   rc.task.results.Collect


Module Contents
---------------

.. py:class:: Collect(csvs = None, folders = None, ignore_missing = False, **kwargs)

   A device for collecting -- i.e. concatenating -- csv files across folders or folds.


   .. py:method:: __call__(dst, is_existing_deleted=False, **kwargs)

      Collect ``self.csvs`` into ``dst``. If and only if ``dst`` is a Repo, ``self.over_folds`` is called instead of ``self.over_folders``.

      :param dst: The destination folder, to house ``self.csvs`` or ``self.folders``.
      :param is_existing_deleted: Whether to delete and recreate an existing ``dst``.
      :param \*\*kwargs: Write options passed straight to ``pd.to_csv``.



   .. py:method:: from_folders(dst, is_existing_deleted=False, **kwargs)

      Collect ``dst/[self.csvs]`` from ``self.folders``.

      :param dst: The destination folder, to house ``[self.csvs]``.
      :param is_existing_deleted: Whether to delete and recreate an existing ``dst``.
      :param \*\*kwargs: Write options passed straight to ``pd.to_csv``.

      Returns: ``self'' for chaining calls.



   .. py:method:: from_folds(dst, is_existing_deleted=False, **kwargs)

      Collect ``dst/[self.folders]`` from ``Fold(dst, [k])/[self.folders]`` for ``k in self.Folds``.

      :param dst: The destination folder, to house ``[self.folders]``.
      :param is_existing_deleted: Whether to delete and recreate an existing ``dst``.
      :param \*\*kwargs: Write options passed straight to ``pd.to_csv``.

      Returns: ``self'' for chaining calls.
